description: Export the records of a model to a CSV or Excel (XLSX) file and return a file reference to store in a file property with a Create or Update step.
label: Export to CSV or Excel

options.name: model-source
options.label: Model to export records from
options.info: The model whose records are exported.

options.name: filter
options.label: Filter
options.info: Data API filter without outer braces, e.g. type: { eq: "{{type}}" }. Use {{name}} to insert a value from Variables in filter; for text add the quotes yourself. Leave empty to export all records.

options.name: filter-variables
options.label: Variables in filter
options.info: The values you can insert in the filter with {{name}}.

options.name: property-sort
options.label: Sort property
options.info: The property to sort the records by. Leave empty to sort by id. Use a property with unique values: records are fetched in pages, so ties can make a record appear twice or not at all.

options.name: sort-order
options.label: Sort order
options.info: The sort direction of the records in the file.

options.name: delimiter
options.label: Delimiter
options.info: The character between the values in a CSV file. Not used for Excel.

options.name: model-target
options.label: Model to save file into
options.info: The model with the file property the file will be stored in.

options.name: property-target
options.label: Property to save file into
options.info: The file property the file will be stored in. Store the reference in it with a Create or Update step.

options.name: file-name
options.label: Filename
options.info: Name of the exported file, without extension: .csv or .xlsx is added.

options.name: export-property-mapping
options.label: Property mapping
options.info: KEY = column name in the file, VALUE = database name of the property (snake_case), e.g. created_at. For a belongs-to relation: relation.property, e.g. company.name. Columns follow this order.

options.name: format-property-mapping
options.label: Format mapping for export columns
options.info: KEY = column name (as in Property mapping), VALUE = Date|<format> (also Datetime|, Time|), e.g. Date|dd-MM-yyyy with the letters y M d E Q H h m s S a, or Decimal|, / Price|, for the decimal separator.

options.name: use-bom
options.label: Use BOM
options.info: Add a BOM character at the start of a CSV file, so Excel reads it as UTF-8. Not used for Excel files.

options.name: escape-formulas
options.label: Escape formulas
options.info: Put a ' in front of CSV text that starts with =, +, -, @ or a tab, so Excel shows it as text instead of running it as a formula. Numbers are left alone. Not used for Excel files.

options.name: reference
options.label: As
options.info: The file reference. Store it in the file property with a Create or Update step.
